senses.gloss: m. (νεικολόγος, not found in Greek Dict.) pleader in a law-suit. Pesik. Baḥod., p. 153ᵇ מנה לך ניקלגיס וכ׳ (corr. acc.) retain for thyself such and such a man as pleader, and thou shalt be acquitted; Yalk. Num. 782; Yalk. Lev. 645 ניקולונ׳ (corr. acc.); Lev. R. s. 29 נקול׳; v. דִּיקוֹלוֹגוֹס.
